summary.text: Jared Carpenter is a Republican state senator from Kentucky who has represented District 34 since 2011 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Jessica McIntosh.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as business development officer at First Southern National Bank.

paragraphs.text: Carpenter earned a bachelor's degree in speech communications from Eastern Kentucky University in 2000.
His professional experience includes work as a business development officer at First Southern National Bank and operating a small rental and development company and a farm in Berea.
Carpenter took office in the Kentucky State Senate on January 1, 2011.
For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Senate Agriculture, Banking and Insurance (chair), Natural Resources and Energy, and Transportation committees.
